item.title: [News] I tried out OpenAI’s new AI keypad — which will be fun for some coders and slightly mystifying to everyone else
item.description: OpenAI has released an AI keypad product designed for developers. While it may be enjoyable for some coders, others may find it confusing.

item.title: [News] VentureBeat Research: Where enterprise AI agent governance hasn't caught up
item.description: VentureBeat Research found that enterprises deployed AI agents without adequate governance, and are now retrofitting to catch up with their own standards, leading to a potential vendor switch or addition within 12 months.

item.title: [News] Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
item.description: Cognition acquired Poke to enhance Devin, its coding agent, with Poke's conversational style and interaction model. This indicates that AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage for companies developing AI assistants.

item.title: [News] Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
item.description: Prentis, a new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus, is in talks to raise $100 million. The lab is betting on automated routine computer tasks replacing coding as AI's biggest use case.

item.title: [News] Robots Are Coming — but Not Everywhere
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang predicted a widespread adoption of humanoid robots similar to generative AI, but research suggests a diverging adoption curve.
